role: Syncs world time and day time to the client (day time negated when doDaylightCycle is off).
scope_reason: In scope: the client keeps its own clock between S03s, which the server sends every 20 ticks (MinecraftServer.java:666) and on respawn or dimension change; after a server time jump (waking from a night's sleep, WorldServer.tick's setWorldTime) the client's sky, lightmap, clock texture and celestial angle lag for up to 19 ticks.

members.name: field_149369_a (world time)
members.note: the total world time; the server player keeps the one sent this tick, the client player the one pending for its next packets

members.name: field_149368_b (day time)
members.note: the day time, negated (s03_rule 0) when doDaylightCycle is off

members.name: S03PacketTimeUpdate
members.note: updateTimeLightAndEntities' S03 every 20th tick counter: the overworld's time before its tick, a Nether or End player's (DerivedWorldInfo) after it; the join, respawn and dimension change send theirs through the load's clock

members.name: readPacketData
members.note: wire framing; the native engine has no network

members.name: processPacket
members.note: handleTimeUpdate: the total, then setWorldTime with its sign as the doDaylightCycle rule (player.h cw_total, cw_day, cw_daylight: WorldClient's own clock, which its tick advances and the renderer's sky, light and clock texture read, csrc/play/play.c)

members.name: func_149366_c
members.note: accessor over the packet's fields; the native packets are plain structs (no getters)

members.name: func_149365_d
members.note: accessor over the packet's fields; the native packets are plain structs (no getters)

members.name: S03PacketTimeUpdate
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

notes: doDaylightCycle is one of the two supported gamerules (AGENTS.md); its off branch negates the day time, which only matters to the unported client mirror. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was not_needed/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). lane/idxlast 2026-09-27: stale since lane/idxclient d5f72a5c and lane/idxworld: WorldClient's clock with the S03 every 20 ticks. idx-clientview-s1's play check compares the client world time at each of its 364 rows (time changes at rows 6, 12 and 28 of its script; it fails at row 20 without the clock).
